name: socialweb-computer-ssh
description: SSH front door and AT Protocol OAuth server for the compute market

ssh-port.description: TCP port for the SSH server (0 = ephemeral)

ssh-public-host.description: Hostname shown in the connect example. Defaults to the public origin's hostname. Set it when another name reaches this door, e.g. an apex domain that resolves to the same address.

http-port.description: TCP port for the OAuth HTTP server

serve-addr.description: Address the OAuth HTTP server binds

state-dir.description: Directory holding the OAuth session store, state store, and SSH host key

host-key-path.description: SSH host key path (generated if missing)

default-command.description: Command run in the guest when the client requests a shell without a command

vm-ready-timeout-sec.description: Seconds to wait for the provisioned guest's SSH to come up

plc-directory-url.description: PLC directory used to resolve handles and DIDs

associations-cache-ttl-sec.description: Seconds a successful key association lookup is cached

label.description: Service name used in structured logs

web-dir.description: Directory served as the web UI

max-sessions.description: Concurrent provisioning runs allowed across all clients; further exec requests are refused

sessions-per-account.description: Concurrent provisioning runs allowed for one account

auth-timeout-sec.description: Seconds an unauthenticated connection may stay open. Must outlast a first connection pausing at the host-key prompt and reading the banner.

session-max-sec.description: Hard ceiling on one provisioning run, after which it is terminated

public-origin.description: Public origin this deployment is reached at, e.g. https://ssh.example.com. Set it when the app sits behind a TLS terminator: the client_id must be an https URL with no port, and a proxied request arrives as plain http. Omit on loopback.

ingress-proxy-host.description: XRPC relay dispatcher host the requester registers with and discovers bidders through

relay-url.description: Comma-separated ATProto relay URLs for firehose bid and event discovery

network-hosts.description: Comma-separated name=address pairs of the market network's service names (its PDSes, PLC, relay) and the loopback address each answers on, copied from the SshGateway's network value

bidder-dids.description: Comma-separated bidder DIDs every RFP is also sent to, besides the bidders found through the relay and the vouch graph

guest-host-aliases.description: Comma-separated /etc/hosts entries ("<ip> <name>") the guest needs to reach the market network's dispatcher and guest TLS front

guest-ca-file.description: PEM CA the guest trusts (cloud-init ca_certs), for a market network whose TLS front has its own CA

guest-curl-home.description: CURL_HOME the guest's systemd manager exports at boot, so the guest's units read the .curlrc the bidder writes

kcp-server.description: The DenoPod's own kcp (the deno runtime sets KCP_SERVER); its base address serves the OpenBaoServer object unless openbao-kcp-server names another

openbao-server.description: OpenBaoServer object that signs users in through its atproto auth mount and holds the requester key and the app PDS key; required

openbao-client.description: Client of the OpenBaoServer whose certificate and kv mount this gateway uses

openbao-client-dir.description: Directory holding that client's certificate (tls.crt), key (tls.key) and the vault CA (ca.crt), kept current by the DenoPod's projected credentials; unset, they are read from the files the OpenBaoServer status names

openbao-kcp-server.description: kcp base address the OpenBaoServer object is read from (default: the base of kcp-server)

openbao-kcp-workspace.description: kcp workspace of the OpenBaoServer object

openbao-kcp-token-file.description: File holding the kcp token that reads the OpenBaoServer object

openbao-kcp-ca-cert-file.description: PEM CA of the kcp that holds the OpenBaoServer object

openbao-atproto-mount.description: Mount of the OpenBao atproto auth plugin that signs users in and holds their sessions

atproto-role.description: Role of the atproto auth mount that every sign-in uses

session-cookie-max-age-sec.description: Lifetime of the browser's session cookie; the OpenBao token behind it expires on its own schedule

listeners-file.description: File the bound listeners (the HTTP server and the SSH server) are written to as JSON once both listen

iroh-dial-socket.description: Unix socket of the iroh dialer that reaches a guest by its iroh ticket (a HostProcess of the ssh gateway application). Unset: run dumbpipe connect in this process

test-owner-sessions-file.description: Market network only: a JSON file keyed by account DID of {service, identifier, password} password sessions used instead of a deposited OAuth session

app-did.description: This deployment's own DID, i.e. the repo its dev.cocore.app.registration record lives in. Defaults to did:web:<public-origin host>. Without --public-origin there is no app PDS at all, since a did:web is resolved by fetching /.well-known/did.json from that origin.

app-handle.description: Handle to declare in the DID document's alsoKnownAs. Defaults to the public origin's hostname. The handle is proved separately by a _atproto.<handle> TXT record pointing at this DID.

app-pds-kv-path.description: Deno KV backing the app repo. Defaults to <state-dir>/app-pds.kv

app-pds-crawlers.description: Comma-separated relay URLs to announce app repo writes to. Only needed if co/core reads the registration record off a relay rather than fetching it from the PDS.

cocore-api-base-url.description: Base URL the co/core pairing endpoints hang off. cocore.dev/api and appview.cocore.dev serve the same backend.

cocore-app-name.description: Name co/core shows on its approval screen and in the user's key list

cocore-return-url.description: Where co/core sends the browser back after approval. Its host must serve /.well-known/cocore-app.json naming this app's DID. Defaults to the public origin.

tls-cert-file.description: PEM certificate to serve TLS with; requires tls-key-file

tls-key-file.description: PEM private key to serve TLS with; requires tls-cert-file

port-file.description: File the bound TCP port is written to once listening (used with port 0)
